info.title: Abwab Al Kheir Pharmacy - CUSTOMER API
info.description:
Mobile app ki tamam APIs (Figma design ke mutabiq)

## Response Format
Sab responses `{success, message, data}` shape mein hain. Errors (401/403/404/422/429/500) mein extra `errors: []` array bhi hota hai — Laravel ke built-in errors (validation, unauthenticated, etc.) bhi isi standard shape mein convert kiye ja chuke hain, controllers ke bahar bhi.

id_token.description: Google SDK se mila ID token

notes.example: Tell us what you are looking for

post.summary: Firebase Phone OTP — Sign Up + Login (ek hi endpoint)
post.description: Mobile app Firebase SDK se OTP bhejta/verify karta hai, phir mila hua id_token yahan bhejta hai. 'name' sirf naye phone number (signup) ke liye zaroori hai.

422.description: Naya user hai lekin name nahi diya

post.description: Email par 6-digit code bhejta hai (15 min valid). Security ke liye response hamesha same hota hai, chahe email exist kare ya na kare.

200.description: Code bhej diya gaya (ya email exist nahi karti, dono cases mein same response)

post.summary: Forgot Password — Step 2: code + naya password

200.description: Password reset ho gaya, purane tokens revoke ho gaye

422.description: Code ghalat/expire, ya koi request nahi ki gayi thi

ErrorResponse.description: Har error (401/403/404/422/429/500) isi shape mein aata hai — Laravel ke built-in errors bhi.

example: The email has already been taken.

SuccessResponse.description: Har successful response (200/201) isi shape mein aata hai.
